title: Floor Loading for Instant External Card Payouts — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
**Loading clause.** A Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service more than half of whose payouts in the month ending today, a month that takes in every payout dated fewer than one whole month before today, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's, went to external debit cards, which are paid instantly on every day of the week, adds 20 percent to its replenishment floor, one with at least one such payout in that month adds 10 percent, and any other service adds nothing for instant payouts.

The destination of each payout is read from the service's ledger; payouts to a Paystride card or to a bank account are not payouts to an external debit card.

| Payouts to external debit cards in the month ending today | Loading |
|---|---|
| more than half of the month's payouts | 20 percent |
| at least one, half or fewer of the month's payouts | 10 percent |
| none | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical counts)

- 9 of 16 payouts to external debit cards: more than half, 20 percent.
- 8 of 16: exactly half, not more than half, 10 percent.
- 1 of 1: more than half, 20 percent.
- 0 of 12: nothing.
